mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dotted line supplies a comparison level of 0.2 for the plotted points. Right image: The dashed horizontal line represents the hidden rear edge of the cube base.
Rationales: The feature marks a fixed output level for comparison in the left image and shows an occluded horizontal edge of a solid in the right image. The red dotted horizontal line through the 0.2 tick. The long horizontal dashed line at the rear of the cube’s bottom face.
